description: AI provider abstraction with the configurable fallback chain (Gemini -> Bedrock -> OpenAI -> Anthropic). Each provider implemented against its real HTTP/SDK API, normalized to one internal AISuggestion shape. Orchestrator skips unconfigured providers, falls back only on timeout/5xx/429/quota/model-unavailable (NOT safety refusals), and re-validates every AI SQL suggestion with the FEAT-002 validator before marking it valid. Credentials never sent to browser or logged. Fully covered by mocked tests (respx/monkeypatch) with no live keys.
steps: Create backend/app/ai/base.py: AIProvider abstract class with name, is_configured() (based on settings), and async suggest(prompt_context) -> AISuggestion. Define AISuggestion pydantic model {suggested_sql, explanation, optimizations[], provider, raw_notes?}. Define exceptions ProviderUnavailable (triggers fallback: timeout/5xx/429/quota/model-unavailable) vs ProviderRefusal/ProviderError (does NOT trigger fallback).

Create backend/app/ai/prompt.py: build a prompt from the user's SQL + normalized schema summary (tables/columns/indexes) + dialect, instructing the model to return corrected/optimized SQL + explanation + optimization list as strict JSON. NEVER include DB credentials or raw sampled sensitive values beyond the opt-in schema context. Include a parser that extracts the JSON result and maps to AISuggestion.

Create provider impls under backend/app/ai/providers/: gemini.py (Google Generative Language REST API, model like gemini-1.5-flash via httpx with API key), bedrock.py (boto3 bedrock-runtime invoke_model using EC2 IAM role / default credential chain, no static key), openai.py (chat completions via httpx), anthropic.py (messages API via httpx). Each maps HTTP 429/5xx/timeouts to ProviderUnavailable, parses response via prompt.py, returns AISuggestion. is_configured() reflects whether its credentials/region are present.

Create backend/app/ai/orchestrator.py: AIOrchestrator reads AI_PROVIDER_ORDER, instantiates providers, iterates in order skipping unconfigured ones, calls suggest(); on ProviderUnavailable moves to next provider; on ProviderRefusal/ProviderError stops (does not fall back). Returns the first AISuggestion plus which provider served it. If none configured or all unavailable, raises AllProvidersUnavailable so the API can degrade gracefully.

Update backend/app/api/optimize.py: after producing rule-based optimizations, call the orchestrator to get an AI suggestion (best-effort). Re-validate the AI suggested_sql with SqlValidator (syntax + schema) and set is_suggestion_valid accordingly; if AI unavailable, return rule-based result with ai_available=false and a message. Never block the deterministic result on AI.

Create backend/tests/test_ai_orchestrator.py using monkeypatch/respx with NO live keys: (a) first provider raises ProviderUnavailable -> orchestrator falls back to the next and returns its suggestion; (b) a ProviderRefusal does NOT trigger fallback; (c) unconfigured providers are skipped; (d) all-unavailable raises AllProvidersUnavailable; (e) an AI suggestion with bad SQL is re-validated and marked is_suggestion_valid=false. Use fake providers / mocked httpx so no network is hit.

Create backend/tests/test_ai_providers.py: for at least gemini and openai, use respx to mock the HTTP endpoint and assert a 200 JSON body is parsed into AISuggestion, a 429 raises ProviderUnavailable, and the API key is read from settings (and never appears in the returned AISuggestion). Bedrock test uses a stubbed boto3 client.
Run ruff/black/pytest and fix until green.
acceptance_criteria: `uv run pytest -q backend/tests/test_ai_orchestrator.py backend/tests/test_ai_providers.py` passes with no network access and no real API keys (all mocked)
Orchestrator falls back on ProviderUnavailable, skips unconfigured providers, and does NOT fall back on ProviderRefusal
Every AI-suggested SQL is re-validated by SqlValidator before is_suggestion_valid is set true
Provider credentials are read from settings/IAM only and never present in AISuggestion or logs
verification: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run black --check . && uv run pytest -q
